General information.Name: Environmental impact of Oaxaca cheese production and wastewater from artisanal dairies under two scenarios in Aculco, State of Mexico
General information.Description: El estudio evaluó los impactos ambientales de la producción de queso Oaxaca en cuatro queserías artesanales del Estado de México mediante análisis de ciclo de vida en 10 categorías de impacto: calentamiento global, agotamiento del ozono estratosférico, formación de partículas finas, formación de ozono, ecosistemas terrestres, acidificación terrestre, eutrofización de agua dulce, ecotoxicidad terrestre, toxicidad humana no cancerígena, escasez de recursos fósiles y consumo de agua. Se calculó la huella de carbono de 1 kg de queso Oaxaca y se evaluaron dos escenarios de manejo de aguas residuales: tratamiento anaeróbico en biodigestor o descarga al sistema municipal.
General information.Tags: LCA, queso artesanal, huella de carbono, aguas residuales, biodigestor, impacto ambiental
General information.Technology | Description: Se utilizó la metodología de Análisis de Ciclo de Vida (LCA) según ISO 14040 con el software SimaPro® v.8.5.0.0 utilizando la base de datos Ecoinvent v.3. El método de evaluación de impacto fue ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint impacts categories. Se realizó análisis de sensibilidad con diferentes escenarios de manejo de aguas residuales y análisis de incertidumbre mediante método Monte Carlo. Se utilizó medidor de energía multifunción WR D-024 para medir consumo eléctrico en tiempo real.

processDocumentation.LCI method: Life cycle assessment (LCA) according to ISO 14040 using SimaPro® v.8.5.0.0 software with ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint impacts categories method, Herarquista (H) v 1.01
processDocumentation.Process type: Artisanal cheese production system from raw milk reception to product delivery at retail market (cradle-to-gate)
processDocumentation.Modeling constants: Functional unit: 1 kg of Oaxaca cheese; 10% of whey considered as lost and allocated to wastewater; 90% of whey considered as avoided product for pig feeding; Time horizon of 100 years for carbon footprint calculation according to IPCC (2013)
processDocumentation.Data source information: Primary data collected through direct observation and 18 semi-structured interviews with cheese-making personnel and dairy owners over one-year period (June 2018 to June 2019); Secondary data from Ecoinvent v.3 database and Mexican electrical energy database (Santoyo-Castelazo et al., 2011)
processDocumentation.Data completeness: Complete coverage of all relevant flows within system boundaries including raw materials, energy, water, transportation, and waste streams; Milk production stage excluded from system boundaries
processDocumentation.Data selection: Inclusion criteria: All inputs and outputs related to Oaxaca cheese production process; Exclusion criteria: Milk production phase prior to dairy reception
processDocumentation.Data treatment: Monthly production data calculated first, then annual averages estimated for functional unit; Statistical analysis using Shapiro-Wilk test for normality and one-way ANOVA for comparisons; Monte Carlo test for uncertainty analysis
processDocumentation.Sampling procedure: Snowball method for participant identification; Four artisanal dairies selected in Aculco municipality; Triplicate measurements for physicochemical analysis of cheese samples
processDocumentation.Data collection period: One-year period from June 2018 to June 2019
processDocumentation.Use advice: Results specific to artisanal Oaxaca cheese production in central Mexico region; Not applicable to industrial cheese production or other geographical regions; Limitations due to use of generic global databases for some inputs
processDocumentation.Completeness: High completeness for system boundaries defined; Complete inventory of all major inputs and outputs; Milk production phase intentionally excluded to focus on cheese processing impacts
processDocumentation.Sources: Ecoinvent v.3 database; Mexican electrical energy database (Santoyo-Castelazo et al., 2011); IPCC (2013) for carbon footprint calculation; Primary data from field research
processDocumentation.Project: Supported by CONACYT project 'Estudio de productos lácteos en el norte del estado de México a través de un S-ACV: Estudio de caso de dos tipos de quesos' 4285/2017/CI and PAPIIT-IN305620 'Repertorios y estrategias culturales de organizaciones y actores en la sustentabilidad de la cadena agroalimentaria de productos lácteos'
processDocumentation.Intended application: Environmental impact assessment of artisanal cheese production; Identification of hotspots for improvement; Comparison of wastewater management scenarios; Carbon footprint calculation for Oaxaca cheese
processDocumentation.Data set owner: Universidad Autónoma del Estado de México and Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México
processDocumentation.Data set generator: Cristina Salas-Vargas, Luis Brunett-Pérez, Valentín Efrén Espinosa-Ortiz, Carlos Galdino Martínez-García
processDocumentation.Data set documentor: Cristina Salas-Vargas, Luis Brunett-Pérez, Valentín Efrén Espinosa-Ortiz, Carlos Galdino Martínez-García
processDocumentation.Access and use restrictions: Copyright restrictions apply; Proper citation required
